snippet.title: Save Me Cows! - Animated Trailer
snippet.description:
New action puzzle game for the Game Boy, Game Boy Color and compatible systems. The game is a nod to ChuChu Rocket! And this video is a nod to an old Japanese Dreamcast advertisement. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NE-zLn6eJJk

Purchase at: https://shop.tykomi.com/products/save-me-cows

Checkout more details at https://www.tykomi.com.
